title: French Gratin with Feta Yeast Bread
description: A classic French-inspired gratin dish topped with a crusty yeast bread and crumbled feta cheese. Perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Slice the french onion and separate the layers. In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the onions until caramelized.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
In a separate bowl, mix the molten cheese and a pinch of salt and pepper.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of caramelized onions.
Top with a layer of molten cheese.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Cut the yeasty bread into 1-inch cubes and place on top of the cheese layer.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese and fresh thyme.
